cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Finance Analysis Manager to join our team specializing in Finance for our Distribution Business Segment.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:
Responsible for leading the development and preparation of financial analysis and evaluating financial plans and budgets for the assigned business unit, function, project or corporation. Develops and prepares annual operating budgets and/or periodic financial reports. Analyzes, evaluates, and develops financial models. Business partners with management to deliver financial results whilst identifying potential areas of opportunities and risk. Designs, develops and manages strategic financial analysis projects as necessary. Manages a team of Financial Analysts. Coaches and mentors financial analysts; assigns work according to availability, skills, and developmental needs; assesses performance and provides feedback to direct reports.
cond_0001.requirements:
Skills
Financial Reporting - Analyzes financial data by evaluating results and solutions to support business decisions; prepares and presents financial information by summarizing data to communicate results in compliance with regulations and stakeholder expectations; partners with stakeholders to drive financial performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies. Business Partnering - Collaborates with stakeholders and develops partnerships to drive performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies; influences the organization by demonstrating knowledge of the business to provide guidance to support the decision-making process and guiding the business towards positive results and organizational alignment; evaluates business environment using measures to mitigate risk and capitalize on opportunities. Financial Planning and Forecasting - Utilizes financial forecast data to provide forward looking projections to facilitate decision making; partners with stakeholders to analyze trends and validate assumptions to provide a forecast that aligns to the organization's goals and strategies. Financial Analysis - Interprets financial data by analyzing trends, variances, opportunities and risks to provide insight to stakeholders regarding financial impact to drive business improvement; evaluates financial results against targets to communicate conclusions to all stakeholders; ensures integrity of financial data by investigating variances and determining corrective actions to resolve identified issues. Manages ambiguity - Operating effectively, even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear. Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise. Directs work - Providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done. Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
Minimum Requirements
College, university, or equivalent degree in Finance, Accounting or related field.
Significant experience, including supervisory experience.
This role has responsibility for AOP and Simulation cycles for DBU BU.
Preferred Requirements
Certified Public Accountant, Certified Management Accountant, Chartered Accountant or similar certification.
The role also manages working capital tracking, business case analysis and capital for DBU.

cond_0019.intro: We are looking for a Finance Analysis Manager to join our team specializing in Finance for our Distribution Business Segment.
cond_0019.responsibilities:
In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:
Responsible for leading the development and preparation of financial analysis and evaluating financial plans and budgets for the assigned business unit, function, project or corporation. Develops and prepares annual operating budgets and/or periodic financial reports. Analyzes, evaluates, and develops financial models. Business partners with management to deliver financial results whilst identifying potential areas of opportunities and risk. Designs, develops and manages strategic financial analysis projects as necessary. Manages a team of Financial Analysts. Coaches and mentors financial analysts; assigns work according to availability, skills, and developmental needs; assesses performance and provides feedback to direct reports.
cond_0019.requirements:
Skills
Financial Reporting - Analyzes financial data by evaluating results and solutions to support business decisions; prepares and presents financial information by summarizing data to communicate results in compliance with regulations and stakeholder expectations; partners with stakeholders to drive financial performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies. Business Partnering - Collaborates with stakeholders and develops partnerships to drive performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies; influences the organization by demonstrating knowledge of the business to provide guidance to support the decision-making process and guiding the business towards positive results and organizational alignment; evaluates business environment using measures to mitigate risk and capitalize on opportunities. Financial Planning and Forecasting - Utilizes financial forecast data to provide forward looking projections to facilitate decision making; partners with stakeholders to analyze trends and validate assumptions to provide a forecast that aligns to the organization's goals and strategies. Financial Analysis - Interprets financial data by analyzing trends, variances, opportunities and risks to provide insight to stakeholders regarding financial impact to drive business improvement; evaluates financial results against targets to communicate conclusions to all stakeholders; ensures integrity of financial data by investigating variances and determining corrective actions to resolve identified issues. Manages ambiguity - Operating effectively, even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear. Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise. Directs work - Providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done. Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
Minimum Requirements
College, university, or equivalent degree in Finance, Accounting or related field.
Significant experience, including supervisory experience.
This role has responsibility for AOP and Simulation cycles for DBU BU.
Preferred Requirements
Certified Public Accountant, Certified Management Accountant, Chartered Accountant or similar certification.
The role also manages working capital tracking, business case analysis and capital for DBU.

Leads the development and preparation of financial analysis, and evaluates financial plans and budgets for the assigned business unit, function, project, or corporation.
Develops and prepares annual operating budgets and periodic financial reports.
Analyses, evaluates, and develops financial models.
Coordinates with management to deliver financial results, identifying potential areas of opportunity and risk.
Designs, develops, and manages strategic financial analysis projects as required.
Manages a team of Financial Analysts.
Assigns work according to availability, skills, and developmental needs; assesses performance and provides feedback to direct reports.
Coaches and mentors financial analysts to support their technical development.
cond_0106.requirements:
Financial Reporting - Analyses financial data by evaluating results and solutions to support business decisions; prepares and summarises financial information in compliance with regulations and stakeholder expectations; coordinates with stakeholders to support financial performance aligned to organisational goals and strategies.
Business Partnering - Works with stakeholders to support performance aligned to organisational goals and strategies; provides guidance to support the decision-making process based on knowledge of the business; evaluates the business environment using measures to mitigate risk and capitalise on opportunities.
Financial Planning and Forecasting - Uses financial forecast data to provide forward-looking projections to facilitate decision making; coordinates with stakeholders to analyse trends and validate assumptions to produce a forecast aligned to organisational goals and strategies.
Financial Analysis - Interprets financial data by analysing trends, variances, opportunities, and risks to provide insight to stakeholders regarding financial impact; evaluates financial results against targets and documents conclusions for relevant stakeholders; ensures integrity of financial data by investigating variances and determining corrective actions.
Manages ambiguity - Operating effectively even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working with others to meet shared objectives.
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering communications that convey a clear understanding of the needs of different audiences.
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
Directs work - Providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done.
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
Optimises work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
College, university, or equivalent degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field required.
Certified Public Accountant, Certified Management Accountant, Chartered Accountant, or similar certification required.
Significant experience required, including supervisory experience.
This role has responsibility for AOP and Simulation cycles for DBU BU. The role also manages working capital tracking, business case analysis, and capital for DBU.

In this role, you will contribute in the following ways:
Coordinate the development and preparation of financial analysis, and work with the team to evaluate financial plans and budgets for the assigned business unit, function, project, or corporation.
Collaborate with the team to prepare annual operating budgets and periodic financial reports.
Work alongside colleagues to analyze, evaluate, and develop financial models.
Partner with management to deliver financial results while helping to identify potential areas of opportunity and risk.
Coordinate and support strategic financial analysis projects as needed.
Manage a team of Financial Analysts, supporting their development and assigning work according to availability, skills, and developmental needs.
Coach and mentor financial analysts; assess performance and provide feedback to direct reports.
cond_0135.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
College, university, or equivalent degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
Certified Public Accountant, Certified Management Accountant, Chartered Accountant, or similar certification.
Significant experience, including supervisory experience.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with AOP and Simulation cycles for a business unit.
Familiarity with working capital tracking, business case analysis, and capital management.
Skills
Financial Reporting - Analyzes financial data by evaluating results and solutions to support business decisions; prepares and presents financial information by summarizing data to communicate results in compliance with regulations and stakeholder expectations; partners with stakeholders to drive financial performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies.
Business Partnering - Collaborates with stakeholders and develops partnerships to drive performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies; influences the organization by demonstrating knowledge of the business to provide guidance to support the decision-making process and guiding the business towards positive results and organizational alignment; evaluates business environment using measures to mitigate risk and capitalize on opportunities.
Financial Planning and Forecasting - Utilizes financial forecast data to provide forward looking projections to facilitate decision making; partners with stakeholders to analyze trends and validate assumptions to provide a forecast that aligns to the organization's goals and strategies.
Financial Analysis - Interprets financial data by analyzing trends, variances, opportunities and risks to provide insight to stakeholders regarding financial impact to drive business improvement; evaluates financial results against targets to communicate conclusions to all stakeholders; ensures integrity of financial data by investigating variances and determining corrective actions to resolve identified issues.
Manages ambiguity - Operating effectively, even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear.
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
Directs work - Providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done.
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

cond_0227.responsibilities:
In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:
Responsible for leading the development and preparation of financial analysis and evaluating financial plans and budgets for the assigned business unit, function, project or corporation. Develops and prepares annual operating budgets and/or periodic financial reports. Analyzes, evaluates, and develops financial models. Business partners with management to deliver financial results whilst identifying potential areas of opportunities and risk. Designs, develops and manages strategic financial analysis projects as necessary. Manages a team of Financial Analysts. Coaches and mentors financial analysts; assigns work according to availability, skills, and developmental needs; assesses performance and provides feedback to direct reports.
cond_0227.requirements:
College, university, or equivalent degree in Finance, Accounting or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Certified Public Accountant, Certified Management Accountant, Chartered Accountant or similar certification required.
Substantial demonstrated expertise in financial reporting — proven ability to evaluate results and solutions to support business decisions; prepares and presents financial information by summarizing data to communicate results in compliance with regulations and stakeholder expectations; partners with stakeholders to drive financial performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies.
Deep knowledge of business partnering — collaborates with stakeholders and develops partnerships to drive performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies; influences the organization by demonstrating advanced knowledge of the business to provide guidance to support the decision-making process and guiding the business towards positive results and organizational alignment; evaluates business environment using measures to mitigate risk and capitalize on opportunities.
Strong command of financial planning and forecasting — utilizes financial forecast data to provide forward looking projections to facilitate decision making; partners with stakeholders to analyze trends and validate assumptions to provide a forecast that aligns to the organization's goals and strategies.
Expertise in financial analysis — interprets financial data by analyzing trends, variances, opportunities and risks to provide insight to stakeholders regarding financial impact to drive business improvement; evaluates financial results against targets to communicate conclusions to all stakeholders; ensures integrity of financial data by investigating variances and determining corrective actions to resolve identified issues.
Proven track record of managing ambiguity — operating effectively, even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear. Exceptional collaboration skills — building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. Exceptional communication skills — developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. Advanced ability to manage complexity — making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Strong ability to manage conflict — handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise. Strong leadership abilities in directing work — providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done. Proven track record of driving results — consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. Deep knowledge of optimizing work processes — knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
Significant experience required, including substantial supervisory experience. This role has responsibility for AOP and Simulation cycles for DBU BU. The role also manages working capital tracking, business case analysis and capital for DBU.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:
Responsible for leading the development and preparation of financial analysis and evaluating financial plans and budgets for the assigned business unit, function, project or corporation. Develops and prepares annual operating budgets and/or periodic financial reports. Analyzes, evaluates, and develops financial models. Business partners with management to deliver financial results whilst identifying potential areas of opportunities and risk. Designs, develops and manages strategic financial analysis projects as necessary. Manages a team of Financial Analysts. Coaches and mentors financial analysts; assigns work according to availability, skills, and developmental needs; assesses performance and provides feedback to direct reports.
cond_0282.requirements:
College, university, or equivalent degree in Finance, Accounting or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Certified Public Accountant, Certified Management Accountant, Chartered Accountant or similar certification required, or willingness to obtain.
Significant experience required, including supervisory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
This role has responsibility for AOP and Simulation cycles for DBU BU. The role also manages working capital tracking, business case analysis and capital for DBU.
Skills and competencies we look for — we value candidates who are developing in these areas and evaluate experience holistically:
Financial Reporting - Experience analyzing financial data by evaluating results and solutions to support business decisions; familiarity with preparing and presenting financial information by summarizing data to communicate results in compliance with regulations and stakeholder expectations; ability to partner with stakeholders to support financial performance aligned to organizational goals and strategies.
Business Partnering - Experience collaborating with stakeholders and building partnerships to support performance aligned to organizational goals and strategies; background in using business knowledge to provide guidance in decision-making processes; exposure to evaluating business environments using measures to mitigate risk and capitalize on opportunities.
Financial Planning and Forecasting - Working knowledge of financial forecast data to provide forward-looking projections to facilitate decision making; experience partnering with stakeholders to analyze trends and validate assumptions.
Financial Analysis - Experience interpreting financial data by analyzing trends, variances, opportunities and risks; familiarity with evaluating financial results against targets and communicating conclusions to stakeholders; ability to investigate variances and determine corrective actions.
Manages ambiguity - Ability to operate effectively even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
Collaborates - Willingness to build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
Communicates effectively - Ability to develop and deliver communications that convey a clear understanding of the needs of different audiences.
Manages complexity - Ability to make sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
Manages conflict - Openness to handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
Directs work - Experience providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done.
Drives results - Ability to consistently work toward results, even under tough circumstances.
Optimizes work processes - Familiarity with effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

cond_0292.intro: We are looking for a Finance Analysis Manager to join our team specialising in Finance for our Distribution Business Segment. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp financial data and see the logic behind business performance quickly.
cond_0292.responsibilities:
In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:
Responsible for leading the development and preparation of financial analysis and evaluating financial plans and budgets for the assigned business unit, function, project or corporation. Develops and prepares annual operating budgets and/or periodic financial reports. Analyzes, evaluates, and develops financial models. Business partners with management to deliver financial results whilst identifying potential areas of opportunities and risk. Designs, develops and manages strategic financial analysis projects as necessary. Manages a team of Financial Analysts. Coaches and mentors financial analysts; assigns work according to availability, skills, and developmental needs; assesses performance and provides feedback to direct reports.
cond_0292.requirements:
Qualifications
Skills
Financial Reporting - Analyzes financial data by evaluating results and solutions to support business decisions; prepares and presents financial information by summarizing data to communicate results in compliance with regulations and stakeholder expectations; partners with stakeholders to drive financial performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies. Business Partnering - Collaborates with stakeholders and develops partnerships to drive performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies; influences the organization by demonstrating knowledge of the business to provide guidance to support the decision-making process and guiding the business towards positive results and organizational alignment; evaluates business environment using measures to mitigate risk and capitalize on opportunities. Financial Planning and Forecasting - Utilizes financial forecast data to provide forward looking projections to facilitate decision making; partners with stakeholders to analyze trends and validate assumptions to provide a forecast that aligns to the organization's goals and strategies. Financial Analysis - Interprets financial data by analyzing trends, variances, opportunities and risks to provide insight to stakeholders regarding financial impact to drive business improvement; evaluates financial results against targets to communicate conclusions to all stakeholders; ensures integrity of financial data by investigating variances and determining corrective actions to resolve identified issues. Manages ambiguity - Operating effectively, even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear. Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise. Directs work - Providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done. Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
Minimum Requirements
College, university, or equivalent degree in Finance, Accounting or related field.
Certified Public Accountant, Certified Management Accountant, Chartered Accountant or similar certification.
Significant experience, including supervisory experience.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with AOP and Simulation cycles for a business unit.
Experience managing working capital tracking, business case analysis and capital planning.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:
Responsible for leading the development and preparation of financial analysis and evaluating financial plans and budgets for the assigned business unit, function, project or corporation. Develops and prepares annual operating budgets and/or periodic financial reports. Analyzes, evaluates, and develops financial models. Business partners with management to deliver financial results whilst identifying potential areas of opportunities and risk. Designs, develops and manages strategic financial analysis projects as necessary. Manages a team of Financial Analysts. Coaches and mentors financial analysts; assigns work according to availability, skills, and developmental needs; assesses performance and provides feedback to direct reports.
cond_0462.requirements:
College, university, or equivalent degree in Finance, Accounting or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Certified Public Accountant, Certified Management Accountant, Chartered Accountant or similar certification required, or willingness to obtain.
Significant experience required, including supervisory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
This role has responsibility for AOP and Simulation cycles for DBU BU. The role also manages working capital tracking, business case analysis and capital for DBU.
Skills and competencies we look for — we value candidates who are developing in these areas and evaluate experience holistically:
Financial Reporting - Experience analyzing financial data by evaluating results and solutions to support business decisions; familiarity with preparing and presenting financial information by summarizing data to communicate results in compliance with regulations and stakeholder expectations; ability to partner with stakeholders to support financial performance aligned to organizational goals and strategies.
Business Partnering - Experience collaborating with stakeholders and building partnerships to support performance aligned to organizational goals and strategies; background in using business knowledge to provide guidance in decision-making processes; exposure to evaluating business environments using measures to mitigate risk and capitalize on opportunities.
Financial Planning and Forecasting - Working knowledge of financial forecast data to provide forward-looking projections to facilitate decision making; experience partnering with stakeholders to analyze trends and validate assumptions.
Financial Analysis - Experience interpreting financial data by analyzing trends, variances, opportunities and risks; familiarity with evaluating financial results against targets and communicating conclusions to stakeholders; ability to investigate variances and determine corrective actions.
Manages ambiguity - Ability to operate effectively even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
Collaborates - Willingness to build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
Communicates effectively - Ability to develop and deliver communications that convey a clear understanding of the needs of different audiences.
Manages complexity - Ability to make sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
Manages conflict - Openness to handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
Directs work - Experience providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done.
Drives results - Ability to consistently work toward results, even under tough circumstances.
Optimizes work processes - Familiarity with effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

cond_0522.responsibilities:
In this role, you will contribute in the following ways:
Coordinate the development and preparation of financial analysis, working with the team to evaluate financial plans and budgets for the assigned business unit, function, project or corporation.
Collaborate with the team to prepare annual operating budgets and/or periodic financial reports.
Work alongside colleagues to analyse, evaluate, and develop financial models.
Partner with management to deliver financial results while helping to identify potential areas of opportunity and risk.
Coordinate strategic financial analysis projects as necessary.
Support and manage a team of Financial Analysts.
Coach and mentor financial analysts; assign work according to availability, skills, and developmental needs; assess performance and provide feedback to direct reports.
cond_0522.requirements:
Financial Reporting - Analyzes financial data by evaluating results and solutions to support business decisions; prepares and presents financial information by summarizing data to communicate results in compliance with regulations and stakeholder expectations; partners with stakeholders to drive financial performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies.
Business Partnering - Collaborates with stakeholders and develops partnerships to drive performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies; influences the organization by demonstrating knowledge of the business to provide guidance to support the decision-making process and guiding the business towards positive results and organizational alignment; evaluates business environment using measures to mitigate risk and capitalize on opportunities.
Financial Planning and Forecasting - Utilizes financial forecast data to provide forward looking projections to facilitate decision making; partners with stakeholders to analyze trends and validate assumptions to provide a forecast that aligns to the organization's goals and strategies.
Financial Analysis - Interprets financial data by analyzing trends, variances, opportunities and risks to provide insight to stakeholders regarding financial impact to drive business improvement; evaluates financial results against targets to communicate conclusions to all stakeholders; ensures integrity of financial data by investigating variances and determining corrective actions to resolve identified issues.
Manages ambiguity - Operating effectively, even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear.
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
Directs work - Providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done.
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
College, university, or equivalent degree in Finance, Accounting or related field required.
Certified Public Accountant, Certified Management Accountant, Chartered Accountant or similar certification required.
Significant experience required, including supervisory experience.
This role has responsibility for AOP and Simulation cycles for DBU BU. The role also manages working capital tracking, business case analysis and capital for DBU.
